#include <iostream>
#include <sstream>
#include <set>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>

using namespace std;

int readInt() {
  int ans = 0;
  bool neg = false;
  char c;
  do {
    c = (char)getchar_unlocked();
    if (c == '-') {
      neg = true;
      continue;
    }
    if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
      ans = ans * 10 + c - '0';
    }
  } while (c != -1);
  if (neg) ans *= -1;
  return ans;
}

long readLong() {
  long ans = 0;
  bool neg = false;
  char c;
  do {
    c = (char)getchar_unlocked();
    if (c == '-') {
      neg = true;
      continue;
    }
    if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
      ans = ans * 10 + c - '0';
    }
  } while (c != -1);
  if (neg) ans *= -1;
  return ans;
}

string readString() {
  stringstream ss;
  char c;
  do {
    c = (char)getchar_unlocked();
    if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') {
      ss << (char)c;
    }
  } while (c != -1);
  return ss.str();
}

int readChars(char* a, int off) {
  int cnt = 0;
  char c;
  do {
    c = (char)getchar_unlocked();
    if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') {
      a[off + cnt++] = (char)c;
    }
  } while (c != -1);
  return cnt;
}

int main() {
  int R, C;
  R = readInt();
  C = readInt();
  long** ch = new long* [61];
  for (int i = 0; i <= 2*(R + C); i++) {
    ch[i] = new long [61];
  }
  for (int i = 0; i <= 2*(R + C); i++) {
    for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
      if (j == 0 || j == i) ch[i][j] = 1;
      else ch[i][j] = ch[i - 1][j - 1] + ch[i - 1][j];
    }
  }
  int v1 = R + C, v2 = R + C;
  long x = 0, y = 0;
  while (v1 >= R && v2 >= R) {
    if (x > y) {
      long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
      long other = ch[v2][R];
      y += cur * other;
      v1--;
    }
    else {
      long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
      long other = ch[v1][R];
      x += cur * other;
      v2--;
    }
  }
  printf("%d\n", (int)abs(x - y));
  set<string> tried;
  for (int i = 0; i <= 2*(R + C); i++) ch[i][i]--;
  char* cntA = new char [2 * (R + C) + 1];
  char* cntB = new char [2 * (R + C) + 1];
  string str = readString();
  for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (R + C); i++) {
    cntA[i + 1] = cntA[i] + (str[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
    cntB[i + 1] = cntB[i] + (str[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
    ch[cntA[i + 1] + cntB[i + 1]][cntA[i + 1]] = 0;
  }
  long best = (long)(1e10);
  dfs(0, 0, v1, v2);
  printf("%ld\n", solve(0, 0, v1, v2));
  delete[] ch;
  delete[] cntA;
  delete[] cntB;
}

void dfs(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
  long diff = abs(x - y);
  if (best <= 1 || diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] >= best) return;
  if (v1 == R - 1 && v2 == R - 1) {
    if (diff < best) best = diff;
    return;
  }
  string key = to_string(x) + to_string(v1) + to_string(v2);
  if (tried.find(key) != tried.end()) return;
  if (v1 >= R) {
    long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
    long other = ch[v2][R];
    dfs(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2);
    ch[v1][R] += cur * other;
  }
  if (v2 >= R) {
    long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
    long other = ch[v1][R];
    dfs(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1);
    ch[v2][R] += cur * other;
  }
  tried.insert(key);
}

long solve(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
  long diff = abs(x - y);
  if (diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] > best) return 0;
  string key = to_string(x) + to_string(v1) + to_string(v2);
  if (cache.find(key) != cache.end()) return cache[key];
  if (v1 < R || v2 < R) {
    if (v1 >= cntA[v1 + v2] && v2 >= cntB[v1 + v2]) {
      int sum = v1 + v2;
      v1 -= cntA[sum];
      v2 -= cntB[sum];
      return ch[v1 + v2][v1];
    }
    return 0;
  }
  long ans = 0;
  char c = str[v1 + v2 - 1];
  if (c != 'B') {
    long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
    long other = ch[v2][R];
    ans += solve(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2);
  }
  if (c != 'A') {
    long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
    long other = ch[v1][R];
    ans += solve(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1);
  }
  cache.insert({key, ans});
  return ans;
}

set<string> cache;
